decisive_items: painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley of the fourth digit
focal tenderness over the flexor sheath and limited active digit motion
response.rationale: R2 is uniquely supported by a painful fluctuant mass along the flexor sheath from web space to A2 pulley, focal sheath tenderness, and limited active motion, localizing infection to the flexor tendon sheath. R1's DIP soft-tissue swelling and elevated WBC are non-specific and lack joint effusion or joint-line tenderness; R4's erythema/swelling cannot explain the fluctuant sheath-based mass.

rejected.why: Only superficial erythema/swelling and elevated WBC; cannot account for fluctuant mass or flexor sheath tenderness.
